headline: Rejected bids for Bridge St. Bridge Rehab, CSO Outfall Metering, and a contractor trailer; approved task orders for Jordan Road Bridge and Jepson Brook.
summary: The committee rejected bids for three projects \u2013 the Bridge St. Bridge Rehab (2026-038), CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services (2026-049), and an enclosed contractor trailer (2026-048) \u2013 and directed staff to rebid each with updated specifications. It also approved a $2,650 change order for the Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs project, a task order of up to $84,529 for Jordan Road Bridge bypass design, and a task order of up to $63,500 for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design. The minutes of the August 24, 2026 meeting were also approved.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 24, 2026, vote 4-0.
Rejected the bid for the 2026-038 Bridge St. Bridge Rehab project and ordered it rebid later, vote 5-0.
Ratified change order #1 for the Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs project, adding $2,650 for masonry shoring and infill wall widening, updating the bid award to $650,395, vote 5-0.
Authorized an LJB Engineering task order for Jordan Road Bridge bypass design and permitting services, not to exceed $84,529, vote 5-0.
Rejected all bids for 2026-049 CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services and ordered a rebid with updated specifications, vote 5-0.
Authorized a Wright-Pierce task order for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design services, not to exceed $63,500, vote 5-0.
Rejected all bids for 2026-048 for one enclosed contractor trailer for Public Works and ordered a rebid with updated cabinet specifications, vote 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: (132-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated August 24, 2026, and to accept and place them on file by the Clerk.
(133-2026) To formally reject the received bid for the 2026-038 Bridge St. Bridge Rehab project and rebid the project at a later date.

(134-2026) To ratify 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs, change order #1, adding the masonry shoring and widening the infill wall to 2\u2019 into the scope of the project with Perryman Construction for a lump sum of $2,650 and an updated estimated bid award of $650,395.
(135-2026) To authorize the LJB Engineering task order for the Jordan Road Bridge bypass design and permitting services for an amount not to exceed $84,529.
(136-2026) To reject all bids for 2026-049 CSO Outfall Flow Metering Services and rebid the service with updated bid specifications after discussions with responding firms.
(137-2026) To authorize the task order for Jepson Brook interceptor manhole rehabilitation design services with Wright-Pierce for an amount not to exceed $63,500.

(138-2026) To reject all bids received for 2026-048 for one (1) enclosed contractor trailer for Public Works, and to rebid the purchase with updated bid specifications for the cabinet portion of the proposal form.

services with Wright-Pierce for an amount not to exceed $63,500.

On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was

On motion of Chairman Chittim, seconded by Mr. Bouh,
